title: PAH-OMC-016 preregisters a resolved radial counting candidate and separates its observable and dynamics obligations
question: After R-508, is there one independently motivated state/cutoff contract to review without altering the original functional or rates or fitting a replacement prior?
finding: The PAH source independently distinguishes amplitude range R_max from resolution M_psi. One new dyadic path R_max=2^j, M_psi=2^(2j) preserves the functional and rate formulas while refining the amplitude mesh. The six-parent hash-pinned candidate retains counting weights and explicitly proposes bounded amplitude cylinders b=min(1,|psi|). These are not the old raw R-488 integer cylinders beyond the base level. The state-set injection preserves amplitude but is not a one-root generator intertwiner. The contract and exact coordinate audit pass 25 checks; the volume-uniform small-ball/tightness gate is not proved.
decision_reason: auxiliary_support: the requested one-candidate redesign review is complete and supplies a discriminating new input contract, but nondegeneracy remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE. No mathematical or physical gate changed.
boundary: Same OMC-004 G_n and PAH-001 functional, couplings, move families, mobility, projection and external time. Newly declared resolved radial cutoff and bounded-amplitude observable topology; K=2, M_s=1, epsilon=1/2, beta=nu=1 remain fixed. j limit precedes n; no full joint cutoff or common-core theorem.
next_action: Prove or refute the preregistered volume-uniform local small-ball bound liminf_j mu_(n,j)(b_v^2)>=c>0 for v=a,d, with tight fixed-n amplitude laws. Do not run more definition tests or tune the candidate. A state lower bound would still not settle Cauchy convergence or limiting dynamics.
method: Read governance, current tasks, canonical source definitions and R-508; run doctor, continuity and direction control.
Compare amplitude-range and radial-resolution meanings using the source coordinate formula, not fitted Gibbs outputs.
Write and hash the new candidate version, six parents, observable topology, limit order and falsifiers before candidate tests.
Compare closed-form exact grid arithmetic with an independently implemented recurrence; reject target substitution, fixed-resolution reuse, root-map identification and equal-sector reweighting.
Record one remaining local small-ball/tightness question, explicit inapplicable imports and the limits of the planning review.
assumptions: New dyadic radial path and explicitly new bounded-amplitude comparison topology.
Full-domain labelled counting reference remains a hypothesis, with unchanged PAH component laws and no Jacobian.
missing_assumptions: Mesh-uniform amplitude tails and expanding-domain quadrature passage.
A volume-uniform local moment and nonzero small-ball estimate; neither follows from finite positivity or a global energy bound.
verification_summary: 25 exact contract/source/independent-recurrence/hostile checks pass. No Gibbs expectation sweep, no new carrier computation and no analytic nondegeneracy proof. Lean not run for a planning/coordinate-only audit; external signed review absent.
non_claims: No R-488 target replacement or repair of the R-508 negative.
PAH-OMC-014 unresolved; no C_sw=540 or old intertwining import to the larger radial grid.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, infinite-volume dynamics, Yang-Mills, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
revisit_condition: A new analytic bound or exact counterexample changes the next action; any change of source, prior, path, witness or time scale requires a new version and audit.
